decisions.title: Use a single EC2 instance with Docker Compose
decisions.statement: A single EC2 instance is sufficient while horizontal scaling is unnecessary.
decisions.reason: Sustained host pressure is evidence that the original 'one instance is enough' assumption deserves review. This is a review trigger, not an instruction to adopt Kubernetes.

decisions.title: Use SSM Session Manager instead of SSH
decisions.statement: Administrative access must not require public SSH ingress.
decisions.reason: The workload deliberately uses SSM for administration, so opening SSH contradicts the accepted architecture decision.

decisions.title: Do not put real secret material in Terraform state
decisions.statement: Terraform may create SecureString parameters, but must not generate or receive the real secret value.
decisions.reason: Values handled by Terraform are persisted in state even when the destination is SSM SecureString.
